# CASEs with `line` `transient-support`

*Lines of inquiry — A named line of the record's own argument, so that a line can be set aside as a whole and what depends on it can be found. Retracting a line is a status change on its members, never a deletion (ADR-032).*

**Withdrawing transient support** — when support that establishes or sustains a party can be withdrawn without its decline — supplied upkeep that never becomes optional, supply that does the party's work and lowers the capacity it keeps, a savings buffer as a stock of time, dependency against division of labour by who supplies, and independence from what founded an organization against independence from what feeds it; split from readiness (ADR-087).

| [CASE-308](../../../record/cases.d/CASE-308.md) | A small assembly model whose scaffold forms and holds a nucleus, withdrawn for good at chosen states: the drop in the chance of completing falls to under 0.05 two units into eight only where the bound units hold the nucleus and it speeds their binding, stays at 0.10 or more to the last unit where they do not hold it, and under withdrawal at a clock time falls to zero in every case as runs finish | [LEAD-095](../../../record/leads.d/LEAD-095.md) asked for a Markov chain in which support can be withdrawn at chosen intermediate states ([QUESTION-398](../../../record/questions.d/QUESTION-398.md)) and the nucleus's relations switched on as a state and as a rate modifier separately ([QUESTION-397](../../../record/questions.d/QUESTION-397.md)). The chain has a nucleus, present or not, and M = 8 other units; a scaffold forms the nucleus fast and stops it dissolving; withdrawal at a state is permanent. A's measure D(s) = q_supported(s) − q_withdrawn(s) was computed exactly by linear solve at every state, in four mechanisms. With both feedback (bound units stabilize the nucleus) and a rate effect (the nucleus triples the binding rate), D falls from 0.085 to under 0.05 at n = 2 and to 0.002 at n = 7, while the chance of completing after withdrawal is already 0.88 at n = 2: independence before completion, not completion. With the rate effect and no feedback, D falls only from 0.35 to 0.10 and the scaffold is needed to the end; with neither, D rises from 0.13 to 0.22 in this parameter set, though not in most of a random sweep. Withdrawal at a clock time shows a drop that falls to zero in every mechanism, because runs finish: A's rival, "the system merely completed before withdrawal", is real under timed withdrawal and excluded by withdrawing at states. With the scaffold absent, switching the nucleus's state and rate effects separately shows both raising the committor at matched progress, with only the binding rate (Δk = 2 against 0) telling them apart. The model is the assistant's and its rates are invented. The wording is the assistant's (Claude, in this session); adopting it is the owner's call. | Proposed |

| [CASE-365](../../../record/cases.d/CASE-365.md) | A kinetic construction in which nuclei form fast only on a teacher and, once formed, make teachers from material: the loop closes, keeping its teacher with no outside supply of it, only below a teacher turnover set by the teaching rate; withdrawal becomes safe on crossing a separatrix, while nuclei are 0.02 % to 30 % of their maintained number; material supply is still needed; nuclei that only repair teachers cut the supply needed but never to zero; and in finite numbers closure is a lifetime that grows with size | [LEAD-093](../../../record/leads.d/LEAD-093.md) asked for a nucleus that, once formed, takes part in producing or repairing the constraints of its own formation, and a measure of when that loop closes ([QUESTION-399](../../../record/questions.d/QUESTION-399.md)), with a student that becomes a teacher ([QUESTION-361](../../../record/questions.d/QUESTION-361.md), [CASE-190](../../../record/cases.d/CASE-190.md)). In the model built here, nuclei form fast only where a teacher is present, cooperatively, and each nucleus makes teachers from material. At the base point, founding by an outside teacher is needed and the loop then holds with the outside teacher withdrawn; it stops closing above a teacher turnover of 0.19, and the material supply can never be withdrawn. The moment withdrawal becomes safe is a crossing of a separatrix in the joint state, reached while nuclei are 0.02 % to 30 % of their maintained number and the self-made share of teacher supply is anywhere from 0.2 % to 65 %. Beyond a turnover of about 0.73 the loop costs more outside teacher supply than no loop. Nuclei that repair teachers without making them divide the supply needed by 1 + ρN/λ and never close. Populations matched in nucleus number close or not by the share of nuclei that can teach. In finite numbers the closed loop is lost after a time that grows roughly exponentially with size. The model and its rates are the assistant's, invented. The wording is the assistant's (Claude, in this session); adopting it is the owner's call. | Proposed |
